events.title: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026
events.description: Asia’s flagship technology and innovation summit bringing together global tech leaders, researchers, deep-tech startups, and policy makers.

ticketTiers.name: Free Day Festival Pass

ticketTiers.name: Rock Night & Pronite VIP

events.title: Jaipur Literature Festival & Cultural Forum

events.venue: Hotel Clarks Amer & Front Lawns, JLN Marg
events.cancellationPolicy: General registration is free. Delegate packages have 7-day refund window.
events.terms: Seating on first-come, first-served basis across lawns and author marquees.
